evals.name: overflow-buttons-page
evals.prompt: 이 페이지(.claude/skills/ui-text-audit/evals/test-pages/overflow-buttons.html)에서 버튼 텍스트가 잘리거나 깨지는 지점을 찾아줘. annotated PNG 와 issues.json 을 만들고 confirmed/suspected 를 분리해서 요약해줘.
evals.expected_output: Confirmed: text_overflow on 결제 진행하기, overlapping_text on 사용자 이름/관리자 권한. Suspected: vertical_text_suspected on 메뉴 열기, text_clipping_suspected on 긴 라벨 ellipsis, bad_padding_suspected on 확인. Annotated PNG saved.

assertions.name: issues_json_exists
assertions.description: .omc/artifacts/ui-text-audit/<slug>/output/issues.json file is created and is valid JSON

assertions.name: layout_json_exists
assertions.description: .omc/artifacts/ui-text-audit/<slug>/output/layout.json file is created and is valid JSON

assertions.name: detects_text_overflow_confirmed
assertions.description: issues.json contains at least one issue with type=text_overflow and confidence=confirmed

assertions.name: detects_overlapping_text_confirmed
assertions.description: issues.json contains at least one issue with type=overlapping_text and confidence=confirmed

assertions.name: detects_vertical_text_suspected
assertions.description: issues.json contains at least one issue with type=vertical_text_suspected and confidence=suspected

assertions.name: report_separates_confirmed_from_suspected
assertions.description: Final summary mentions confirmed and suspected counts separately, not lumped together

evals.name: clean-control-page
evals.prompt: 이 페이지(.claude/skills/ui-text-audit/evals/test-pages/clean.html)를 검사해줘. 깨진 곳이 없으면 그렇게 보고해줘.
evals.expected_output: Confirmed: 0 issues. Suspected: 0 or only padding/wrap noise. The control page should not produce any text_overflow, container_escape, or overlapping_text findings.

assertions.name: no_confirmed_issues
assertions.description: issues.json contains zero items with confidence=confirmed

assertions.name: report_states_clean
assertions.description: Final summary explicitly says the page is clean (no confirmed issues), not just stays silent
